AP News (Jon Gambrell & Collin Binkley), Wed 22 Jul 2026 08:19 GMT — Trump warned Wednesday the US "will destroy one bridge or power plant each time Iran shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz." Truth Social: "From this point forward, any time the Islamic Republic of Iran shoots at a ship in the Strait of Hormuz, whether it be by Missile, Rocket, Drone, or any other device or weapon, the United States will bomb and destroy ONE BRIDGE OR POWER PLANT, including those located next to, or in, the Capital City of Tehran."
US carried out an 11th night of strikes overnight into Wednesday (targets incl aircraft hangars, drone storage). Air defences opened fire over Tehran. Iran launched a missile attack on a Jordanian city on Israel's doorstep; alerts issued in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. Iran's Health Ministry: US strikes over the past 11 days have killed 53 people (incl six women, three children) and wounded nearly [cut]. AP frames war as "spiralling with no clear offramp... sending fuel prices up ahead of midterm US elections this fall." Strait "remains largely closed because of Iranian attacks."
Cross-ref BBC (bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cdrv0p37k8jo): Trump threatens Pickaxe Mountain (Kuh-e Kolang Gaz La) near Natanz "pretty soon, and very heavily"; explosions Tabriz, Chabahar, Konarak, Bushehr; Iran's Khatam al-Anbiya command would treat a nuclear-site attack as "an expansion of war."
